phase.waiting_for_agent: Waiting for the device to start sending…
phase.paused: Live view is paused on the employee's device

error.MEDIA_FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to watch this device.
error.MEDIA_DEVICE_NOT_FOUND: This device is not in your account.
error.MEDIA_AGENT_OFFLINE: The device is offline. It will be available when it reconnects.
error.MEDIA_MONITORING_DISABLED: Monitoring is turned off for this device.
error.MEDIA_OUTSIDE_SCHEDULE: Live view is outside this device's scheduled screen-monitoring hours.
error.MEDIA_SESSION_ENDED: This session has ended. Start a new one.
error.MEDIA_PROVIDER_UNCONFIGURED: Live video is not enabled on this deployment yet.
error.MEDIA_PROVIDER_ERROR: The video service rejected the request.
error.unknown: Something went wrong starting live view.

failure.DENIED_BY_POLICY: The monitoring policy does not allow watching this device right now.
failure.ICE_FAILED: The network blocked the video connection.
failure.CAPTURE_FAILED: The device could not capture its screen.
failure.ENCODER_FAILED: The device could not encode video.
failure.ROOM_FAILED: The video service dropped the session.
failure.TIMEOUT: The device did not start sending in time.

offline: The employee's device is offline — live view will be available when it reconnects.

hint.agentSlow: the device may be waking up or starting its recorder

pause.locked: The screen is locked. Live view resumes by itself when it is unlocked.
pause.private_app: A private app is open (privacy-protected). Live view resumes when it closes.
pause.paused: The employee paused tracking. Live view resumes when they continue.

timeout.noAgent: The device did not respond. Check that the app is running and the device is awake.
timeout.noFirstFrame: The device connected to the video service, but no screen image arrived.
timeout.lostVideo: The video dropped and did not come back in time.
timeout.noSession: The session did not start in time.

reason.wgc_unsupported: Windows screen capture is not ready (usually right after waking from sleep).
reason.no_monitor: No display is attached to the device.
reason.start_failed: Windows refused to start screen capture.
reason.no_first_frame: Screen capture started, but no image arrived.
reason.capture_closed: Screen capture was closed (graphics reset or session change).
reason.resumed_from_sleep: The device woke from sleep and could not restore screen capture.
reason.display_changed: The displays or resolution changed and capture could not recover.
reason.publisher_start_failed: The streaming helper could not start on the device.
reason.publisher_exited: The streaming helper stopped repeatedly on the device.
reason.signed_out: The employee is not signed in to the app.
